versions.prompt:
Reference 1 is a real photo of the restaurant's burger. Reference 2 shows its real paper and table. Create a wide cinematic campaign photograph of this same kind of burger, in a true scene.

The burger: a soft brioche bun with a lightly glazed, slightly uneven golden crown and a few natural wrinkles; two thin smashed beef patties with dark, craggy, lacy crispy edges; real melted cheddar pooling irregularly over the meat; a loose pile of crispy fried onions; a couple of pickle slices barely visible. Nothing else in the burger.

Scene: late evening, the burger rests on slightly crumpled greaseproof paper on a worn black steel counter at the pass of a small working restaurant kitchen. Composition: the burger sits in the right third of the frame, low in the image, and occupies only about 28% of the frame width: this is a wide shot, the place matters as much as the product. The left 55% of the frame falls into almost pure black shadow, with only faint warm reflections on the steel and a few very soft out-of-focus kitchen lights far behind, leaving calm space for a headline. A single warm lamp from the upper right rakes across the bun and the cheese. A thin wisp of steam rises from the burger. Palette: deep blacks, warm brown and amber.

Style: real editorial advertising food photography, captured on location with a medium-format digital camera and an 80mm lens around f/4. One warm practical tungsten key light and very little fill, natural falloff into deep shadow, faint film grain, believable micro-texture. Slight human imperfection everywhere: uneven crumbs, irregular cheese drips, small grease marks. It must look photographed, not rendered.
Strictly forbidden: any text, letter, number, logo, sticker, label or watermark; plastic-looking cheese; waxy or CGI surfaces; a perfectly symmetrical bun; impossibly tall stacks; floating ingredients; HDR look; oversaturated colours; oversharpening; toppings not explicitly listed.
